title: Cold Weather Changes What Your Car Needs
caption: Cold mornings in Saskatoon can expose worn battery connections, low tire pressure, and aging wipers. Before the first freeze, check your battery, inflate tires to the numbers on the driver-door label, and confirm your wiper blades clear properly. If a warning light appears, address it early rather than driving farther than needed.

title: If a Breakdown Happens, Make Safety the First Step
caption: If your vehicle stalls or becomes unsafe, move to a legal location where possible, turn on hazard lights, and stay clear of traffic when it is safe to leave the vehicle. Call roadside assistance or a local tow service, and describe your exact location and vehicle situation clearly. Never stand behind traffic or attempt repairs in an unsafe spot.

caption: A strange noise, warning light, or failed start can turn one problem into a missed day.
